runs.notes: file-level green = every executed test in the file passed and the file reported no out-of-test error; skipped-only, no-tests (upstream file declares no runnable test) and blocked-external (needs a service/registry/toolchain this environment lacks) are their own buckets and are NOT passes
direct execution (mbun <file>, exit 0 = pass); node's own harness services (// Flags:, internal bindings) are not emulated, so files needing them count as failures
